text:
amanda: Heads-up from sales: they want a single slate we can hand prospects that explains routing lanes, guarantees, and what triggers premium pricing. Need something concise and defensible.

ryan: Can we call it a commercial-readiness checklist? Short, actionable.

sana: I can draft that. Thinking sections: scope, customer guarantees (SLOs), gating criteria, operational controls, pricing implications.

keiko: From ops: include a mandatory runbook drill and a telemetry contract. Without that, SRE will not sign off.

oliver: Also add a short paragraph on "overflow behavior" (soft-evict -> degrade model -> spill to global). Customers ask this a lot.

amanda: Good. Sales needs explicit triggers they can promise: e.g., "dedicated lane" requires 3mo capacity commit + signed TOS.

ryan: For SLAs suggest: regional availability 99.9% (Phase 1), p99 tail latency SLO for dedicated lanes, and RTO for cross-region failover in Phase 2.

sana: Proposal for phases (novel phrasing):
- Starter (0-90d): policy primitives, per-tenant hints, sticky affinity. No commercial SLA yet.
- Ready (90-240d): tenant lanes, reserved pools, runbook + 7d canary; eligible for SLA.
- Hardened (>240d): policy DSL, active-active failover, eviction budgets, jurisdictional controls.

keiko: Gating checklist bullets: capacity commit, telemetry events emitted (policy_decision, route_fallback, kv_reconcile), canary pass, compatibility matrix published, runbook drill completed.

oliver: Compatibility matrix idea: score each model family 0-3 for lane suitability (0 unsupported, 3 fully compatible). We'll use that to qualify premium lanes.

amanda: Pricing model callout: uplift banded by compatibility score and tail-latency guarantee. Finance needs assumptions.

finance-bot: Action: finance requested estimated uplift ranges (low/med/high) per compatibility band and expected revenue impact.

ryan: Acceptance criteria for a lane to be "commercial":
- 7d canary with 5% traffic across two regions
- p95/p99 within 15% of baseline for production models
- KV parity tests green for replicateable workloads
- Runbook drill executed with <10m manual recovery time
- Pricing uplift approved by finance

sana: Concrete example policy snippet to show customers:
```
policy_name: "regional_preference_v1"
preferences: ["latency","residency"]
regions: ["us-west1","eu-central1"]
tenant_hint: {affinity: "regional", fallback: "global"}
```

keiko: Ops addendum: define an auto-fallback SLI: if error rate delta >1% sustained >5m on canary, route fallback for affected tenants.

oliver: Customer FAQ section: explain "what happens during overflow", "how to request dedicated lane", and "how pricing is calculated". Keep it 3 bullets each.

amanda: Next steps: Sana to produce a one-pager commercial-readiness checklist + sample SLA language by EOD Thu. Keiko to attach telemetry spec. Oliver to draft compatibility scoring rubric. Finance to return uplift ranges in 5 business days.

ops-bot: Canary scheduled: perf-harness against eu-us pair Tuesday 08:00 UTC. Owner: sana.

ryan: Thanks. If we make the checklist crisp we can close two backlog deals this month.

sana: On it, will post draft in #product and ping sales.
